measures.title: Duval County School District Ad Valorem Millage Election
measures.summary: Asks whether the Duval County School District should continue its current one-mill property tax for essential operating expenses, including pay for teachers, security and support staff, and preserving academic programs, arts, athletics and student activities. The levy would run from July 1, 2027 through June 30, 2031, be shared proportionately with charter schools, and come with annual reporting.
measures.yesMeans: The current one-mill school operating levy continues from July 1, 2027 to June 30, 2031.
measures.noMeans: The current one-mill levy is not continued for that period.
